# Supplementary Material {#sec-appendix}

Appendices contain material that would interrupt the flow of the main text,
e.g. detailed proofs, additional measurements, questionnaires or longer
listings. They are listed in `_quarto.yml` under `book: appendices:` and are
numbered with capital letters.

The declaration of authorship follows on the next page. It is generated from
`_quarto.yml` (`thesis: declaration:`). In some degree programs, the
declaration must be placed directly after the cover page instead; set
`declaration: after-cover` in this case.
